reason: My admin already logs the transfers and I check the receipts myself since I got burned. I might run the free 40 documents, but I won't pay $19 a month for something that's already being done unless it catches something we missed.
objection: The receipts that burned me were inflated, not duplicated. A contractor writing a higher number on a real nota still adds up, so a bot checking totals and duplicates wouldn't have caught it. And I don't love putting all my business documents through a bot I don't know.
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial on my old chat history turned up a duplicate or a padded receipt that my admin and I missed, I'd pay for it that week.
